body:
Founder real-time: "get PITVIPER working" (obs 2026-08-13T22:41:12Z).

Real compile bug fixed: cmd/pitviper/main.go:228 assigned terminal.Close (func(), PTY's real
signature) to connClose (declared func() error, matching mudconn.Conn.Close's real signature) --
wrapped in a closure rather than changing PTY's own public API for one caller. GOWORK=off go
build and go test both clean now.

Also found and flagged (not fully audited): CLAUDE.md's "Milestone 0 not started" claim is stale
-- real code already exists well past Milestone 0 (689-line main.go, 842-line vterm with its own
555-line test file, PTY handling, GFD API integration, MUD connection support).
docs/NORTHSTAR.md's own per-milestone status checkboxes look similarly stale. A real
milestone-by-milestone audit against actual code wasn't done this pass -- separate, real
follow-up work, flagged honestly rather than guessed at.

Founder's other 2 PITVIPER asks (SSH hotkey into iduna.farthq.com, installable-as-terminal-client
like SHANKPIT/GFD/REDGARDEN) not started -- real feature work on top of a codebase whose actual
current milestone status isn't yet verified, so scoping those precisely should probably wait for
the audit above.

title: Fixed compile error; flagged stale Milestone 0 claim
